description: MARK THE MIXPANEL TIMELINE: write what just happened into Mixpanel at the moment it happened, so every chart afterwards shows it in place. The same closed loop as the PostHog and Amplitude annotation tools, worth reaching for unprompted after a campaign goes live, a creative is swapped or a landing page changes. `date` is "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" (Mixpanel's own format, charted in the PROJECT's timezone), "YYYY-MM-DD", or an ISO timestamp with its offset (written in the project's timezone so the mark sits at that exact instant, read back to prove it); omit it for NOW. tags are numeric annotation-tag ids. The stored row is read back. Mixpanel only lets a service account with at least the ANALYST role write annotations; a lower role is refused by name, and that is a role change in Mixpanel, not a reconnect. 0 credits. Needs Mixpanel connected.

date.description: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss", "YYYY-MM-DD" or ISO with offset; default now

description.description: the text shown on the chart, e.g. "Meta: summer UGC campaign went live"

name: create_mixpanel_annotation
title: Mark the Mixpanel timeline
